Claude Code: Native SwiftUI Hotlympics iOS app (ratings, leaderboards, uploads, profiles).

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app; simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In via Swift Package Manager. After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Entry `App/ios_appApp.swift`: Firebase/Google Sign-In URL schemes. Rating and Leaderboard unrestricted; Upload, My Photos, Profile require authentication and complete profile.

Services: `auth/FirebaseAuthService` Google OAuth, session/tokens, backend sync, gender/DOB, ToS, profile comp
